breakpoints.behavior: Narrow settings dialog; smaller deck button and topbar alignment. Some earlier rules are superseded by the later 720px play-shell rules.

Mobile play area max 480px. Items are horizontal 48px slots. Augment region becomes collapsible. Choice cards stack and change to horizontal information layout. Board gap/padding and tray size reduce.

contrastAudit.method: sRGB relative luminance: channel <= 0.04045 => channel/12.92, else ((channel+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; L=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; ratio=(Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05). RGB values are not rounded before calculation.
contrastAudit.limitations: Static foreground/background pairs only. This is a likely-risk audit, not a rendered accessibility certification. Endpoint samples do not account for radial overlays, shadow outlines, exact viewport position, antialiasing or disabled-control exemptions. Classification of a text style as large must use its actual rendered size and weight.

proposedImprovements.proposal: Map existing CSS colors to Figma primitive and semantic variables, keeping the original sourceName in descriptions. White cards and dark modals are simultaneous surface families, not existing light/dark theme modes.
Create named text styles from the observed roles; settle an explicitly available Korean/Latin font pairing before treating fallback rendering as visually canonical.
Normalize a shared spacing scale only after review. Do not silently replace the extracted 3/5/7/14/18/22px values with a new 4px scale.
Add consistent primary/secondary disabled and focus-visible treatments; keep existing board, item and deck states.

Review the calculated risks, especially white icons on light blue, normal white text on accent/slot fills, category labels, and muted text over the page gradient. Preserve observed colors in the source library and mark any revised contrast-safe palette separately.
Promote observed timings to named motion tokens and define reduced-motion behavior for burst/cell/score animations; existing reduced-motion CSS only targets auto-undo effects.

contentMismatches.detail: Brand naming differs: README heading Polyo, start screen Polyomino, HTML title Block Blast React.
README describes basic deck up to 20, while disabled start action copy requires 10 normal blocks. Source UI copy should be reviewed before documentation is frozen.
